rationale: USCo's USD operating account has a surplus of 175,000 USD above the projected minimum cash requirement over the next 30 days. To prudently allocate excess cash while preserving liquidity, a partial investment of 175,000 USD into the low-risk, daily-liquidity tokenized money market fund (TMMF-USD-01) is proposed. This maintains sufficient liquidity for obligations and aligns with the objective of prudent partial allocation.
